messages:
Priya: Capturing takeaways from today's nav IA review — focus: task-based left-nav groups, breadcrumb rules, and deep-link fallbacks. Prototype: https://proto.redwood.dev/nav-task-groups
Ethan: I like task-based groups (Manage / Serve / Observe). fewer cross-links when people search.
Nora: Breadcrumb rule: only show persistent route segments. panels (logs, diff) are UI state, not bread crumbs. keeps trail stable.
Sam: Implementation note: open panels via query param (?panel=logs) so links remain shareable and analytics friendly. hash is ok but less visible to analytics.
a11y-bot: accessibility-check: ensure focus moves to main heading after route change; when a panel opens trap focus and mark background aria-hidden.
Priya: Fallback behavior for auth failures: redirect to parent list with a toast "You don't have access to that resource" + CTA to request access. avoid 404s.
Ethan: Persist left-nav collapse in localStorage for speed, sync to profile on login. prehydrate to avoid flicker.
Nora: Microcopy tweak: rename 'Instances' to 'Compute instances' to reduce ambiguity. I'll draft tooltips too.
Sam: QA: I'll run keyboard-nav flows on staging when PR is up. please tag PR with 'nav-ia'.
Priya: Thanks — plan: land grouping + breadcrumb contract first, panels-as-query next, persisted prefs after. Share staging link when ready.
